{{Top|leg}}
A "'''she-voork'''" was a derogatory term; the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] considered the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Korelei]] a "she-voork" for anticipating their moves during their [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]]. The Jedi [[Ben Skywalker]] also considered the Sith [[Vestara Khai]] a "she-voork" for lying to him.
